utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, everybody. Mr. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-95-9-A, the Prosecutor versus Blagoje Simic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Simic, can you follow the proceedings in a language that you understand? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Yes, I do. I can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let us have the appearances, starting with the Office of the Prosecutor.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: Peter Kremer, Q.C., appearing for the Prosecutor. Barbara Goy is with me.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. And for the Defence of Mr. Simic.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Mr. President. I am Igor Pantelic, attorney at law from Belgrade, and next to me you have my colleague, who is going to introduce himself.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Good afternoon. Peter Murphy. I also represent the accused.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And this case, Mr. Simic filed a notice of appeal against the decision, the judgement issued against him on the 17th of October, 2003. Whilst he's awaiting the appeal, he is being detained in the Detention Unit, in the UN Detention Unit here in The Hague. Pursuant to Rule 65 bis (B), a Status Conference shall be convened every 120 days, so that the detained person awaiting appeal can raise any question relating to the proceedings, but also questions related to his physical and mental health. So we have been meeting for the sixth -- five times before, so meeting today for the sixth time. Mr. Simic, do you personally, or through your counsel, wish to mention specific complaints or concerns relating to your detention conditions or to your health? You'll have the floor. THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have no comments I wish to make at the moment, and as to the conditions at the Detention Unit and my state of health, both are satisfactory. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. With regard to the progress of the appeals file, I observe that no motion has been filed with the Chamber. As to oral submissions, I want to tell you that the Appeals Chamber is minded to have a hearing towards the end of February, 2006. In this respect, I do ask Mr. Simic's Defence counsel and the Prosecution to tell me now already whether do they acknowledge there will be any major reason why they could not attend such a hearing in February? Mr. Pantelic.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Your Honour, the only observation that we would have is this: At the last Status Conference, we did indicate some concern about an amicus brief that had been filed in connection with the appeal in the case of Brdjanin concerning the law on the subject of joint criminal enterprise. Your Honour, we are still awaiting further filings in that decision, and we're not clear as yet as to whether or not those legal issues might affect this case. We would only ask for the record that the Appeals Chamber bear in mind that if that issue is going to be decided in the Brdjanin case, it may, of course, have repercussions for a number of other cases which are at present awaiting hearings. And so it may be, Your Honour, that perhaps at a later date we could make further representations to the Appeals Chamber, if that becomes necessary. But, Your Honour, subject to that, we, of course, have no difficulty with the date at the end of February.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. I have taken due note of what you have just said.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. We have no difficulty with the date proposed.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much. [Interpretation] In due time, you will be apprised of all necessary details regarding the hearing to come. As for me, I have nothing else on my list. Do you have any observations or questions? For the Defence?

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour, nothing to add. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. This being so, in the absence of any other observation or comment, this hearing stands adjourned. Thank you very much.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
